001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.util.Objects;
004import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
005
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherFactory;
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider;
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.publisher.BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher;
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.publisher.BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisherBuilder;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
011
012/**
013 * Registry of publishers. Rainbow Gum registers default publishers with the following
014 * schemes:
015 * <ul>
016 * <li>{@value #SYNC_SCHEME} - default sync publisher</li>
017 * <li>{@value #ASYNC_SCHEME} - default async publisher</li>
018 * <li>{@value #BATCH_SWAP_SCHEME} - {@link BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher}</li>
019 * <li>{@value #DEFAULT_SCHEME} - by default this is the same as
020 * {@link #SYNC_SCHEME}.</li>
021 * </ul>
022 * Plugins may override the above so that the above is automatically replaced with other
023 * providers via the service loader.
024 *
025 * @see RainbowGumServiceProvider
026 */
027public sealed interface LogPublisherRegistry extends LogPublisher.PublisherProvider {
028
029        /**
030         * Register a publisher provider by URI scheme.
031         * @param scheme uri scheme.
032         * @param publisherProvider provider.
033         */
034        public void register(String scheme, LogPublisher.PublisherProvider publisherProvider);
035
036        /**
037         * This is URI scheme for the async publisher used by the publisher builder. Call
038         * {@link #register(String, io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider)} with
039         * this scheme to replace the default async publisher.
040         * <p>
041         * A module registering a replacement must support the {@value #BUFFER_SIZE_NAME} URI
042         * query parameter. Both {@link PublisherFactory#ofAsync(Integer)} and
043         * {@link LogPublisher.AsyncLogPublisher.Builder#bufferSize(int)} pass the requested
044         * capacity through that parameter. The corresponding named property is
045         * {@value #BUFFER_SIZE_PROPERTY}.
046         */
047        public static String ASYNC_SCHEME = "async";
048
049        /**
050         * Explicit scheme for {@link BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher}, independent of which
051         * implementation is registered as the default {@link #ASYNC_SCHEME} publisher.
052         */
053        public static String BATCH_SWAP_SCHEME = "batchswap";
054
055        /**
056         * This is the URI scheme for the sync publisher builder to find a sync publisher.
057         * Call {@link #register(String, io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider)}
058         * with this scheme to replace the default sync publisher.
059         */
060        public static String SYNC_SCHEME = "sync";
061
062        /**
063         * This is the URI scheme for the default publisher.
064         * {@link #register(String, io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider)} with
065         * this scheme to replace the default publisher.
066         */
067        public static String DEFAULT_SCHEME = "default";
068
069        /**
070         * Because publisher configurators through service provider discovery can replace the
071         * default schemes of {@link #ASYNC_SCHEME}, {@link #SYNC_SCHEME} all the builtin core
072         * providers are prefixed with this value so that they can still be used even if
073         * overriden.
074         */
075        public static String BUILTIN_SCHEME_PREFIX = "core.";
076
077        /**
078         * Key parameter for the URI scheme a publisher was selected with, without
079         * {@value #BUILTIN_SCHEME_PREFIX}.
080         */
081        public static final String SCHEME = "scheme";
082
083        /**
084         * Default async buffer size.
085         */
086        public static final int ASYNC_BUFFER_SIZE = 1024;
087
088        /**
089         * Buffer Size property name.
090         */
091        public static final String BUFFER_SIZE_NAME = "bufferSize";
092
093        /**
094         * Buffer Size Property for Async publishers.
095         */
096        public static final String BUFFER_SIZE_PROPERTY = LogProperties.PUBLISHER_PREFIX + "{" + SCHEME + "}."
097                        + BUFFER_SIZE_NAME;
098
099        /**
100         * Default time in milliseconds an async publisher's close waits for queued events to
101         * be written.
102         */
103        public static final int ASYNC_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT = 10_000;
104
105        /**
106         * Shutdown timeout property name.
107         */
108        public static final String SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_NAME = "shutdownTimeout";
109
110        /**
111         * Milliseconds an async publisher's close waits for queued events to be written.
112         */
113        public static final String SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_PROPERTY = LogProperties.PUBLISHER_PREFIX + "{" + SCHEME + "}."
114                        + SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_NAME;
115
116}
117
118final class DefaultPublisherRegistry implements LogPublisherRegistry {
119
120        private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, PublisherProvider> providers = new ConcurrentHashMap<String, LogPublisher.PublisherProvider>();
121
122        @Override
123        public PublisherFactory provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
124                ref = DefaultLogProviderRef.normalize(ref);
125                var uri = ref.uri();
126                String scheme = uri.getScheme();
127                if (scheme == null) {
128                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("URI is missing scheme. uri: " + uri);
129                }
130                var provider = providers.get(scheme);
131                if (provider == null) {
132                        throw LogProviderRef.NotFoundException.of(ProviderModule.ComponentType.PUBLISHER, scheme, uri,
133                                        providers.keySet());
134                }
135                return provider.provide(ref);
136        }
137
138        @Override
139        public void register(String scheme, LogPublisher.PublisherProvider publisherProvider) {
140                providers.put(scheme, publisherProvider);
141        }
142
143        /**
144         * Creates a publisher registry instance.
145         * @return publisher registry.
146         */
147        static LogPublisherRegistry of() {
148                var r = new DefaultPublisherRegistry();
149                for (var p : DefaultPublisherProviders.values()) {
150                        r.register(p.scheme(), p);
151                        r.register(BUILTIN_SCHEME_PREFIX + p.scheme(), p);
152                }
153                return r;
154        }
155
156}
157
158enum DefaultPublisherProviders implements LogPublisher.PublisherProvider {
159
160        DEFAULT {
161                @Override
162                public String scheme() {
163                        return LogPublisherRegistry.DEFAULT_SCHEME;
164                }
165
166                @Override
167                protected PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProviderRef ref, LogProperties properties) {
168                        return (n, config, appenders) -> new DefaultSyncLogPublisher(appenders.asSingle());
169                }
170        },
171        SYNC {
172                @Override
173                public String scheme() {
174                        return LogPublisherRegistry.SYNC_SCHEME;
175                }
176
177                @Override
178                protected PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProviderRef ref, LogProperties properties) {
179                        return (n, config, appenders) -> new DefaultSyncLogPublisher(appenders.asSingle());
180                }
181
182        },
183        ASYNC {
184
185                @Override
186                public String scheme() {
187                        return LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_SCHEME;
188                }
189
190                @Override
191                protected PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProviderRef ref, LogProperties properties) {
192                        return BATCH_SWAP.provide(name, ref, properties);
193                }
194        },
195        BATCH_SWAP {
196
197                @Override
198                public String scheme() {
199                        return LogPublisherRegistry.BATCH_SWAP_SCHEME;
200                }
201
202                @Override
203                protected PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProviderRef ref, LogProperties properties) {
204                        return new BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisherBuilder(name, schemeKey(ref)).fromProperties(properties, ref).build();
205                }
206        };
207
208        @Override
209        public PublisherFactory provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
210                return (n, config, appenders) -> provide(n, ref, config.properties()).create(n, config, appenders);
211        }
212
213        public abstract String scheme();
214
215        /*
216         * The scheme filling {scheme} in the publisher's keys: the one written in the URI, so
217         * async settings apply to whichever publisher is registered as async, without the
218         * builtin prefix.
219         */
220        static String schemeKey(LogProviderRef ref) {
221                String scheme = Objects.requireNonNull(ref.uri().getScheme());
222                return LogProperties.removeKeyPrefix(scheme, LogPublisherRegistry.BUILTIN_SCHEME_PREFIX);
223        }
224
225        protected abstract PublisherFactory provide(String name, LogProviderRef ref, LogProperties properties);
226
227}
